name: Filling Of The Holy Spirit
overview: The Filling of the Holy Spirit, as revealed in Scripture, is a vital empowerment for believers to live boldly and effectively for Christ. Jesus promised the Father would send another Comforter to abide with believers forever (John 14:16), and the apostles received power when the Holy Spirit came upon them to be witnesses to the world (Acts 1:8). Repentance and baptism in Jesus' name lead to receiving the gift of the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38), resulting in bold proclamation of God's Word (Acts 4:31), spiritual renewal (Acts 9:17), and joy (Acts 13:52). This filling equips the believer for ministry and a Christ-centered life.
